description: NaPrS₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PrS₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent PrS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are four shorter (2.88 Å) and two longer (3.12 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Pr³⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form PrS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PrS₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent PrS₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are two shorter (2.85 Å) and four longer (2.88 Å) Pr-S bond lengths. There are four inequivalent S²⁻ sites. In the first S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Pr³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Pr₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the second S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Pr³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Pr₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the third S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Pr³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Pr₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There is one shorter (2.85 Å) and two longer (2.88 Å) S-Pr bond lengths. In the fourth S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Pr³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Pr₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are two shorter (2.88 Å) and one longer (3.12 Å) S-Na bond length. There is one shorter (2.85 Å) and two longer (2.88 Å) S-Pr bond lengths.
